neighbours.label: ' Win' as the Windows key in keyboard-shortcut instructions ('press Win + E', 'the Win key'). Other modifier keys (Ctrl, Alt, Shift) fire more weakly; the verb 'win' and other key names stay quiet.
fire: To lock your computer in a hurry, press Win + L before you leave the desk.
You can open the Run box by holding the Win key and tapping R.
The quickest way to show the desktop is to press Win + D.
In the settings guide, tap Win + I to bring up the control panel.
If the taskbar disappears, press the Win key once to bring it back.
Snap a window to the left half of the screen with Win + Left Arrow.
To take a screenshot of one region, press Win + Shift + S.
On most laptops the Win key sits between the Fn and Alt keys.
quiet: To lock your computer in a hurry, press the power button before you leave the desk.
You can open the Run box by clicking the Start menu and typing its name.
The quickest way to switch windows is to press Alt + Tab.
In the settings guide, tap Ctrl + P to bring up the print dialog.
If the taskbar disappears, press the Esc key once to bring it back.
Our chess club hopes to win the left half of the draw this year.
To select one whole line, press Shift + End.
On most laptops the Fn key sits between two smaller keys in the bottom row.

notes: Card: ' Win' x3 of the top 32, with ']' x5, '0' x5, ')' x3 before a ' +' (the pole's output promotes ' +', ' plus'), so the wider pattern is 'a plus sign comes next'. Probes did not support the wider pattern: '[name] + aliases' 0.06, 'base price plus tax' 0.03, while ' Win' fired with the plus (1.07) and without it (0.92). Ctrl 0.41, Shift 0.22, Alt 0.17, Winamp 0.19, verb 'win' 0.004. Label is at the token level; the code/number half of the card is not covered.
